bib.title: Learning How to Ask: Querying LMs with Mixtures of Soft Prompts

question: Can prompts for eliciting relational knowledge from a frozen pretrained LM be learned by gradient descent, and does that reveal more knowledge than hand-written or mined prompts?
hypothesis: Tuned continuous prompts, mixed as an ensemble, elicit more of an LM's factual knowledge than discrete prompts, so earlier work underestimated it.
contributions: Soft prompts: continuous vectors tuned by gradient descent, initialised from hard prompts or randomly
Deeply perturbed prompts: additive perturbations at every layer
Mixture of soft prompts with learned weights, optionally data-dependent
Large gains over LAMA, LPAQA and AutoPrompt on T-REx, Google-RE and ConceptNet

method.summary: The LM is frozen. For each relation, a set of cloze prompts (token vectors) and mixture weights are trained to minimise the log-loss of the mixture predictive distribution over (x,y) pairs. Variants perturb every layer and weight prompts by data-dependent Bayes terms.
method.task: Relational knowledge extraction by cloze prompts (single-token answers)

datasets.name: T-REx original
datasets.split: inherited train/val/test split from Shin et al. (2020)
datasets.preprocessing: y a single token under the LMs used by LAMA

datasets.name: T-REx extended

datasets.name: ConceptNet
datasets.source: Speer et al. 2017 via LAMA (OMCS, Singh et al. 2002)
datasets.preprocessing: per relation, only prompts appearing more than 10 times are kept, giving 1-38 prompts

datasets.name: T-REx original, distinct-y split

models.name: BART-base / BART-large
models.architecture: encoder-decoder; decoding constrained to fill the y slot with a single token

other.note: BART results not comparable with others (single-token filter under BART tokenization)

training.objective: minimise sum over (x,y) of -log sum_t p(t|r) p_LM(y|t,x) (Eq. 2); softmax parameterisation of mixture weights; log T also tuned in the data-dependent variant
training.epochs: 16 (choose the best on dev); early-stop patience 4
training.regularisation: early stopping; small perturbations at deeper layers
training.wall_clock: tuning a single prompt takes a few minutes even for BERT-large-cased on T-REx extended; scales roughly linearly with number of prompts

other.soft prompt params: 6d for a 6-token prompt at layer 0; 6d(L+1) when all layers perturbed
other.random init: each word of a mined prompt replaced with a Gaussian vector fit to the LM's word embeddings

inference.samples: one run per configuration; seeds not stated
inference.prompting: cloze prompt with x and y blanks

parameters.prompt sources: sin. (1 LAMA prompt), par. (13-30 LPAQA paraphrases), min. (6-29 LPAQA mined), ran. (random init of min. prompts)
parameters.mixture T: temperature on p(x|t,r)^(1/T), log T learned

eval.protocol: Average over all test examples; sign test p<0.02 (Table 1) or paired permutation test p<0.02 (Table 5); baselines from prior papers or reimplementations (dagger).

prompts.text: x performed until his death in y.
